items.t: Here's How Much $100 Invested In Twilio 10 Years Ago Would Be Worth Today

items.t: Guava Adds WebRTC SDK, SIP Calling and Warm Transfers to Get Voice Agents onto Calls
items.sum: LOS ANGELES, November 11, 2026--Guava, the developer platform for building voice agents, today announced four additions that make it easier to put an agent on a call: a WebRTC SDK, SIP calling, optimized Guava phone numbers and warm transfers.
